atelier hours

For makers with day jobs

The hours behind every piece.

Atelier Hours is your digital atelier, for everything that happens before a piece is finished. Collect fragments, let them grow into concepts, and share the finished piece with a buyer by link or QR label.

Atelier Hours is in a private pilot in Amsterdam. Invitations open in 2026.

The phone is a live demo. Try it: tap a fragment, open a piece, switch makers with the avatar.

01 · The problem

Making happens in fragments. Most apps only see the finished piece.

Scattered

What inspires a piece lives across the camera roll, screenshots and saved posts. The thinking stays in your head.

Performed

Social apps reward finished output, likes and follower counts. They make the quiet part of a practice feel like work.

Unseen

Buyers meet the finished piece, rarely the practice behind it. With AI images everywhere, human making is easy to claim and hard to show.

02 · How it works

Collect fragments. Shape a concept. Make the piece.

  1. 1

    Fragment

    Your own photos, references saved from Instagram or Pinterest, and passing thoughts. Everything that feeds a piece, in one place.

  2. 2

    Concept

    Gather fragments around one idea over weeks or months. Concepts become the backbone of a collection.

  3. 3

    Piece

    Mark the finished work. Any medium: a painting, a lamp, a flower piece, a garment.

  4. 4

    Share with a buyer

    Send a link or print a QR label. Buyers make it theirs, or inquire. Your fragments stay private.

03 · Makers

One studio, very different practices.

EEva Han

Painter and photographer

Sea, sky and streets in the last light of the day, from city to island.

MMei Takeda

Interior designer and lighting maker

Paper, linen and wood: light softened for lived-in rooms.

JJieun Kwon

Florist and floral stylist

The gesture of a single stem, and vegetables treated as flowers.

04 · Principles

Calm by design.

Process over output

Fragments count as much as finished pieces. The app shows how a practice grows, not how it performs.

No likes, no feed

No follower counts, streaks or algorithm. Nothing to keep up with.

Private first

Everything stays on your phone. Only the pieces you choose to share have a public page.

A visit can become a sale

Every piece is one link or one QR code away from a buyer, with payment built in.

05 · Roadmap

Built in phases, each earning the next.

Now

Studio

Fragments, concepts and pieces. Free for invited makers.

Next

Share and sell

Buyer pages, QR labels and payment. Makers subscribe once they sell.

Later

Quiet hours

Book idle hours in independent cafés, shops and studios for pop-ups and workshops.

Later

Explore

Find ateliers and spaces nearby, city by city, once enough makers are in.
